authority: User: 권장안으로 진행하자. Representative figures plus retained detailed evidence; pilots 2/5/7 then all eight.

design.photo: Exact existing crop and rigid rotation; no retouch. Focus A is one supplied patch.
design.selection: Within the original frozen section band and target cell, require the stated case conjunction; choose closest to section midpoint, then closest to centreline, then patch ID. Post-result illustrative selection, not representative sampling.
design.layout: Two photos with exact A locator; input/result full fixed sections with A raw sample; same vertical limits. Separate exact A normal-error ruler for unambiguous threshold crossing.
design.stats: Target-region crop area rates and same-cell/same-judgment area; never whole-crop rate as case rate.
design.reference: Supplied reference only. Cell uses source mvs_a_e; normal distance is not its substitute.
design.missing: No MVS remains missing. Photo shortage means selected_count < 3, not physical invisibility.
design.result: Supplied analytic loss minima, no training, inference, geometry editing, or photo-check rerun.
